text:
Alice: Morning async — quick standup. What I did: landed the microbatch fairness change (PR #4321), ran a small KV eviction sweep, and repro'd the p99 spike from yesterday on my local rack. Blockers: still seeing occasional OOM in the 8k token path when batch_size > 32, not sure if it's kernel or shard sizing. Today: want to instrument the slot allocator and run a focused perf sweep; will open a short-lived canary with batch_size=24.

Ben: Nice. Can you drop the canary link when ready? I can watch logs and compare slot steal events. Re: OOM, did you already toggle the new eviction threshold?

Alice: Yep toggled to 0.65 in config and replayed the failing trace — OOM persisted. Kernel-level traces show uneven batch slot distribution right before the crash.

Carlos: FYI I pushed a tiny patch (PR #4330) that adds backpressure when kv_fetch latency > 60ms. Might help if the backend delay is causing oversized batches to pile up.

Diana: Quick heads up — I'm on the perf bench this morning. Can we coordinate exact traffic shape? I want a mix: 60% short (<=256 tokens), 30% med (512), 10% long (8k). I'll run three iterations at t=10m each.

Alice: That shape sounds perfect. I'll run the canary concurrently in us-west and tag the job.

Ben: If we're running long traces, add the `--kv-warmup=1` flag to avoid cold misses skewing numbers. Command I usually use: `./benchdriver --shape mixed --concurrency 40 --kv-warmup=1 --report=csv`

DeployBot: Deployment queued: canary/us-west/batch-24 by Alice. Start ETA 2m. Links: https://ci.redwood/deploys/5761

Carlos: I'll tail the canary logs and watch for repeated slot handoffs. If I see >3 handoffs in a 5s window we'll rollback.

Diana: Running iteration 1 now. First pass looks clean, p50 ~ 45ms for short, p95 ~ 210ms. Long path has p99 spikes around 1.3s but no OOM yet.

Alice: Canary started. Observing slightly higher KV miss rate (2.8%) vs baseline (1.1%). Suspect prefetching not engaging for the long traces.

Ben: On it — I'll flip prefetch debug on for the canary and capture kv_prefetch hits in /metrics.

Carlos: Noted a small memory bump in the canary node at 11:10:42 — +350MB sustained. Could be cumulative cache entries. Adding a temporary TTL trim to the canary.

Diana: Iteration 2 looks similar. No crash yet. p99 long improved to 950ms after TTL trim. Keep an eye on slot variance; it's still ±3 slots per shard which is higher than ideal.

Alice: Thanks — I'll file a follow-up to adjust slot balancing heuristics (will include logs). If canary survives iteration 3, plan to promote to canary/scale=3 for a broader test.

Ben: Small ask: can someone review PR #4330 (Carlos) and #4321 (Alice)? Both look safe but would like a quick set of eyes before we widen the canary.

Carlos: Reviewing now, leaving inline comments on the backpressure thresholds.

Alice: Thx. Blocker update: if we still hit OOM after scale=3, I'll toggle the kernel OOM-guard which caps batch memory at 78% and report back.

Diana: I'll finish the third iteration and post the CSV. If all green, we can schedule a more comprehensive bench tomorrow with region-cross traffic.

Ben: I'll be in standby for log comparisons. Ping me when you post results. :thumbsup:

Alice: Thanks team — will post canary results shortly and create the follow-up ticket for slot balancing.

DeployBot: Canary completed: deploy 5761 succeeded (health checks passed). Duration 7m.

Alice: Canary looks stable for initial run. Done for today unless anyone has urgent asks.

Carlos: Great work. No urgent asks here.

Diana: CSV attached in thread (uploaded): perf-mixed-1719876544-iter3.csv

Ben: Confirmed — baseline vs canary diff in p99 long improved by ~22%. Looks promising.

Alice: Closing standup. Will follow up on PRs and ticket later today.
